Engineering a better future

Smiths is solving some of the toughest problems facing the world today, to engineer a better future.

Pioneering progress for 175 years

In 2026 we are proud to mark a major milestone: 175 years of Smiths. 

We have been on a remarkable journey from a humble watchmaker's shop in south London, to a global engineering powerhouse. 

Though far removed from our beginnings, we continue to build on our heritage of innovation, technical excellence and pioneering spirit.

Learn more about our history

We are proud of our past, and focused on our future. Learn more about our amazing history and the events that have defined us, and watch our latest video.  

175 years of Smiths
Innovation at Smiths

From shop floor to space today

We are proud to provide components to the 2026 historic space mission, Artemis II, from across multiple parts of our business. Watch the epic video to learn more about Smiths involvement in the mission.

What we do

Our technology benefits millions of people every day. We design, manufacture and deliver engineering solutions for mission-critical applications in energy, industrials, construction and aerospace that drive productivity, efficiency, sustainability and growth. Our products include the high-performance mechanical seals and couplings that support energy and new energy infrastructure, custom tubing for aviation and space platforms, ducting and components for home and commercial HVAC, electrical heating solutions for industry and cooling systems for data centres.

John Crane

A global leader in mission-critical technologies and services that drive efficiency, safety and sustainability in energy and large-scale process industries.

More Find out more

Flex-Tek

Innovative engineered components for safe, efficient, heating, cooling and movement of liquids and gases.

Investment case

We are a high-quality business with strong financial flexibility and a clear opportunity to deliver sustainable growth and attractive returns for shareholders.

We have strong market positions with clear competitive advantages and growth prospects, and world-class engineering expertise. We have a clear strategy for growth, and our talented people have the capabilities to succeed.
